'''Tin ore''' can be turned into [[Tin]] in a [[Smelter]] using [[Coal]] as fuel.

This can be further processed at a [[Forge]] with two [[Copper]] to yield [[Bronze]]. Tin is used to open up cooking options for better food.

== Availability ==
It can be mined from [[Tin deposit]]s which can be found along the shorelines and riverbanks of the [[Black Forest]] [[Biomes|biome]] using any [[Pickaxes (Skill)|pickaxe]].

== Notes ==
* Like other metals, {{PAGENAME}} cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]].
* Tin Ore can be found by breaking open barrels near [[Abandoned_Outpost#Greydwarf_Tower|stone ruins]] in the Black Forest, making it possible to find and smelt Tin ''before'' obtaining a pickaxe.
